expected.finding: **[P2]** [Fail when push retries are exhausted](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/.github/workflows/archive-and-recommend.yml:238). After four rejected pushes, execution continues and an existing PR makes the step report “updated in place” and exit successfully. The new round was never persisted and is lost when the runner exits. The rebuild loop also silently accepts exhausted retries. Track success and exit nonzero if no push or verified no-change result succeeds.

**[P2]** [Check branch ancestry before skipping a rebuild](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/.github/workflows/archive-and-recommend.yml:370). Matching archive contents do not establish mergeability. An analyzer started before a main-branch merge can read the rebuilt archive, then successfully push it with another round on its older checkout. Subsequent rebuilds skip that branch because the calculated file matches, leaving its merge conflict unresolved. Require the current default-branch commit to be an ancestor before skipping, and refresh the analyzer’s base when retrying.

+  rebuild-archive-branches:
+    name: Rebuild open archive branches on the merged archive
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    if: github.event_name == 'push'
+    # When one archive PR merges, every other open archive-rounds-pr-* branch
+    # still claims the round number that just landed and shows a conflict
+    # that would never clear (its own PR may already be merged, so no review
+    # run will rebuild it). Rebuild each on the new default branch with
+    # scripts/merge-archive-rounds.py; a branch that would not change is
+    # left alone.
+    permissions:
+      contents: write
+      pull-requests: read
+    concurrency:
+      group: archive-and-recommend-rebuild
+      cancel-in-progress: false
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout (default branch — trusted)
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Set up Python
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: "3.12"
+
+      - name: Rebuild each open archive branch
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
+          git config user.email "[REDACTED][bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
+          default_branch=$(gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef --jq .defaultBranchRef.name)
+          : > "$RUNNER_TEMP/empty.jsonl"
+          # --limit 1000: gh's default of 30 would silently skip older archive
+          # PRs (Codex review of PR #49, finding 2).
+          for branch in $(gh pr list --state open --base "$default_branch" --limit 1000 \
+              --json headRefName,isCrossRepository \
+              --jq '.[] | select(.isCrossRepository == false) | .headRefName | select(startswith("archive-rounds-pr-"))'); do
+            for attempt in 1 2 3 4; do
+              git fetch origin "$branch" || break
+              lease=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
+              git show FETCH_HEAD:docs/self-improvement-archive.jsonl > "$RUNNER_TEMP/standing.jsonl" || : > "$RUNNER_TEMP/standing.jsonl"
+              python3 scripts/merge-archive-rounds.py \
+                docs/self-improvement-archive.jsonl "$RUNNER_TEMP/standing.jsonl" \
+                "$RUNNER_TEMP/empty.jsonl" "$RUNNER_TEMP/merged.jsonl" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/merge-result.json"
+              if cmp -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/merged.jsonl" "$RUNNER_TEMP/standing.jsonl"; then
+                echo "$branch: already on the current archive."
+                break
+              fi
+              rounds=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(len(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["rounds"]))' "$RUNNER_TEMP/merge-result.json")
+              git checkout -q -B "$branch" "origin/$default_branch"
+              cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/merged.jsonl" docs/self-improvement-archive.jsonl
+              git add docs/self-improvement-archive.jsonl
+              # Every round already on the default branch: the branch has
+              # nothing left to propose; leave it for its PR to be closed
+              # rather than failing the loop (Codex review of PR #49, finding 3).
+              if git diff --cached --quiet; then
+                echo "$branch: all of its rounds are already on the default branch; nothing to rebuild."
+                git checkout -q "origin/$default_branch"
+                break
+              fi
+              git commit -q -m "chore: archive ${rounds} review round(s) (rebuilt on the current default branch)"
+              # Leased on the commit this run read: if the analyze job pushed a
+              # newer round meanwhile, refetch and merge again instead of
+              # overwriting it (Codex review of PR #49, finding 1).
+              if git push --force-with-lease="refs/heads/${branch}:${lease}" origin "$branch"; then
+                echo "$branch: rebuilt with ${rounds} round(s)."
+                git checkout -q "origin/$default_branch"
+                break
+              fi
+              echo "$branch: lease lost on attempt ${attempt}; retrying."
+              git checkout -q "origin/$default_branch"
+              sleep $((attempt * 3))
+            done
+          done
+
